type Values<T> = { [K in keyof T]: T[K] }[keyof T];
function all<T extends { x: number }>(value: T['x']): T[keyof T] { return value; }
function mapped<T extends { x: number }>(value: T['x']): Values<T> { return value; }
function key<T, K extends keyof T>(value: T[K]): T[keyof T] { return value; }
function indirect<U extends { x: number }, T extends U>(value: T['x']): U[keyof U] { return value; }
function unrelated<T extends { x: number }, U extends { x: number }>(value: T['x']): U['x'] { return value; }
console.log(all<{ x: 1 }>(1), mapped<{ x: 2 }>(2), key<{ x: number }, 'x'>(3));
function equal<T extends {x: number,y: number}>(value: T['x']):T['x' | 'y'] { return value; }
function equal2<T extends {x: number,y: number}, K extends 'x' | 'y'>(value: T[K]):T['x' | 'y'] { return value; }
console.log(equal<{ x: number; y: number }>(4), equal2<{ x: number; y: number }, 'x'>(5));
